name: Mas de Barberans (Spain)
description: Red field with three narrow horizontal stripes of white, black and white below the centre, charged at the upper hoist with a white fleur-de-lis.
history: The official flag of Mas de Barberans is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with three fesses of width 1/9 of the height set at 1/3 from the lower edge, white, black and white, and a white fleur-de-lis at the hoist corner of height 4/9; approved on 23 August 1995 and published in the DOGC.

features.role: three narrow fesses of 1/9 set at 1/3 from the lower edge
